title: Canonical open-pullback comparison and restricted coefficient construction
statement: Let derived categories of module sheaves be given for every scheme [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-scheme]. For an open U of Y, construct the isomorphism from derivedPullback U.ι to exact derived open restriction [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps] using the ordinary tensor-pullback adjunction comparison, finite exactness and leftDerivedUnique with the pinned counit [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition]. For g':X'→X, K in D(O_X), K' in D(O_X'), and φ:L(g')*K→K', and opens U,U' and j:U'→U with j≫U.ι=U'.ι≫g', define the restricted coefficient by pullback of the inverse open comparison, the pinned composition comparison for j,U.ι, transport by this equality, the inverse composition comparison for U'.ι,g', the second open comparison, and exact restriction of φ. This is a construction, with no choice of an arbitrary coefficient witness.

def singleComplexRestrictedCoefficient
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X X' : Scheme.{u}} (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (K' : schemeDerivedCategory X')
    (φ : (derivedPullback g').obj K ⟶ K')
    (U : X.Opens) (U' : X'.Opens) (j : U'.toScheme ⟶ U.toScheme)
    (hj : j ≫ U.ι = U'.ι ≫ g') :
    (derivedPullback j).obj ((schemeOpenRestriction X U).mapDerivedCategory.obj K) ⟶
      (schemeOpenRestriction X' U').mapDerivedCategory.obj K'
